PLAN "12-Week Vegan Muscle Gain - 150g Plant Protein Daily"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build muscle mass; eat 150g plant protein per day (tofu, tempeh, seitan, lentils, soy milk, pea protein)"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper A":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 1m
      DAY Tuesday training 60m "Lower A":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          leg_press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 1m
      DAY Thursday training 60m "Upper B":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 1m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Lower B":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          split_squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
